empf_A_minus_previous_vs_stream_spread.note: The previous default rescored on two stream namespaces (folds 0-2, same fits) differs by up to previous_stream_to_stream_max_abs; an EMPF-minus-previous mean difference no larger than that is within the reference's own Monte Carlo spread and should not be read as an effect.

secondary.interval_availability: Previous default: folds 0-2 seeds 0-1 use the CPU M32 covariance-challenge rescore (current32, same stream namespace [20261114,6] as the EMPF readouts, pinned by covariance_challenge artifact_audit_complete_20261116); the CPU M32 empirical-challenge rescore (namespace [20261114,1]) of the same fits is a stream-sensitivity row. The original GPU six-fit default_pass files carry historical metrics but no interval scores. Folds 3-8 seeds 0-1 use the CPU count-shape confirmation (namespace [20261109,2]). Stage-blind resampling: folds 0-2 have two streams (matched to seed by replicate) in each challenge; folds 3-8 have one stream per fold, reused for both seeds (hence the fold-level SE). No values are invented for any other fold.
